name: Chu Hsi
bio: Chu Hsi (朱熹, 1130–1200) was a Sung poet.

The poems here are from the Qianjiashi (千家詩, Poems of a Thousand Poets), the Song-Ming schoolroom anthology of Tang and Song verse attributed to Xie Fangde and Wang Xiang, taken from the chinese-poetry dataset (MIT); the original characters are given as printed there.

poems.title: 春日 (Chun ri)
poems.author: Chu Hsi
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
勝日尋芳泗水濱，無邊光景一時新。
等閒識得東風面，萬紫千紅總是春。

poems.title: 題榴花 (Ti liu hua)
poems.author: Chu Hsi
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
五月榴花照眼明，枝間時見子初成。
可憐此地無車馬，顛倒蒼苔落絳英。

poems.title: 觀書有感 其一 (Guan shu you gan qi yi)
poems.author: Chu Hsi
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
半畝方塘一鑑開，天光雲影共徘徊。
問渠那得清如許，爲有源頭活水來。

poems.title: 泛舟 (Fan zhou)
poems.author: Chu Hsi
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
昨夜江邊春水生，艨艟鉅艦一毛輕。
向來枉費推移力，此日中流自在行。
